name: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal Mayrhofen
kurzbeschreibung: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal in Mayrhofen: 6,000 m² show dairy, show farm with animals, and tastings of Zillertal hay milk specialties.
beschreibung:
Overview

The tradition-rich ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal is located on the northern outskirts of the popular tourism hub Mayrhofen in the Zillertal (Schwaz district) at an elevation of around 630 meters. Managed by the founding Kröll family in its third generation, the facility pairs state-of-the-art food processing with an interactive educational and leisure experience for the whole family. Across more than 6,000 square meters, the destination offers in-depth insights into the traditional refinement of pure Tyrolean Heumilch (hay milk) from cows, sheep, and goats into exquisite cheese, butter, and yogurt.

Show Dairy & Show Farm

The core enterprise was founded in 1954 and expanded in 2004 to become Tyrol's first show dairy. Along a glazed viewing gallery above the production lines, visitors watch live through large panoramic windows as tens of thousands of liters of fresh Zillertal hay milk arrive daily from around 400 mountain farms and are processed according to heritage recipes. Through interactive multimedia stations and audio guides (in several languages), master cheesemakers explain coagulation in copper vats, shaping, salt baths, and the months-long aging of cheese wheels in climate-controlled cellars. A highlight of the visit is the Genuss-Station, where guests can sample diverse Zillertal cheese specialties – from mild Zillertaler Bergkäse to tangy Graukäse. Just a few steps away lies the SchauBauernhof: a sprawling outdoor area featuring modern open-air barns, a petting zoo, goat climbing mountain, giant hay jumping castle, and a tractor obstacle course for children, illustrating animal welfare and circular agricultural practices.

Visit & Getting There

The ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal (show dairy and show farm) is open year-round: daily from 09:00 to 17:00 (until 18:00 in summer). Production in the dairy is most active in the morning until around 14:00. Combined ticket for show dairy & show farm (2025/2026 season): adults approx. €15.50, youth (ages 15 to 18) approx. €11.50, children (ages 6 to 14) approx. €8.00, children under 6 free; family ticket approx. €39.00. Discounts are available with the regional Zillertal Activcard. The farm shop and restaurant 'Sennereiküche' can be visited without an admission ticket. By car: via the Inntalautobahn A12 (exit Wiesing/Zillertal), follow the B169 valley road approx. 30 km to Mayrhofen (large free parking lots directly at Hollenzen 116). By public transport: take the Zillertalbahn (train or bus) to Mayrhofen station, then regional buses to the Mayrhofen ErlebnisSennerei stop, or walk approx. 15 minutes.

Tips

The entire facility of the show dairy and show farm is barrier-free and wheelchair-accessible, allowing families with strollers to explore every area with ease. Stop by the on-site restaurant Sennereiküche to savor traditional Zillertaler Kasspatzln or Zillertaler Krapfen made with freshly produced cheese. In the farm shop, all specialties can be purchased vacuum-packed to take home.
